newsitem.title: UK: Copper slightly lower in LME evening trade.
newsitem.headline: Copper slightly lower in LME evening trade.

text.p: Copper prices edged lower in London Metal Exchange (LME) evening inter-office trade as buyers remained cautious ahead of a likely further rise in Exchange inventories of the metal when data is released Tuesday morning.
But business was slow and price moves took place in very little volume, traders said.
At 1900 GMT three months delivery was indicated at $2,126/$2,128 against $2,130 last traded in the afternoon on the Exchange floor.
Aluminium, however, maintained earlier steadiness as traders and analysts remained optimistic over the metals 1997 prospects from both a fundamental and technical viewpoint.
It was last quoted at $1,552/$1,554 compared with last afternoon business at $1,550 a tonne.
